newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch Van Leer to expand in Latin America.
newsitem.headline: Dutch Van Leer to expand in Latin America.

text.p: Royal Packagings Industries Van Leer NV said on Wednesday it had taken steps to expand in various Latin American countries.

In Chile, a joint venture has been set up with Industrias Codigas SA to produce steel drums. Van Leer will also start producing steel drums in Mexico and it is making polycarbonate water bottles in Colombia with Reid Plastics of the U.S.
"This is expected to generate an additional annual turnover of about 10 to 12 million guilders," the Dutch group said.
It currently posts annual turnover of almost 300 million guilders in Latin America with outlets in 12 countries.

Van Leer holds a 51 percent interest in the Chilean joint venture with Industrias Codigas. By combining the steel drum activities of both companies, Van Leer-Cogas SA has improved its market position, Van Leer said.
The company said production of steel drums in Mexico should be operational in early 1998. Mexico is the largest Latin American country where it does not have steel drum production.
The joint operation with Reid Plastics in Colombia to produce polycarbonate bottles has started at van Leer's Colombian production site.
